fixtures: True angular momentum r cross mv and legacy single/chain sign conversion
Undamped energy/vertical momentum and per-link constraint residuals

Canonical native state/share/provenance round trips and unknown/unsupported analysis rejection
Worker cancellation, stale replies, sparse/final samples, last-valid-state recovery
physics.limitations: Fixture measurements are not universal error bounds. Polar regularization and embedded projection are inherited algorithms. Gravity conserves the vertical angular-momentum component, not the full vector. Fixed rigid links do not model slack/contact/collision.

execution.routeDeparture: Terminates worker; retains config/tray only, not prior trajectory.

visual.observations: All 12 new Windows desktop/mobile workspace, embedded inspector, diagnostics, library and retained mock light/dark images directly inspected. Existing images preserved. Canvas contain sizing matches centered SVG projection on wide layouts.

failuresAndRecovery: Usage-limit interruptions resumed within the same S12 scope; no model override or claim to inspect the app selector.
Sandbox Git/subprocess restrictions resolved through authorized escalation.
New missing-sample fixture initially assumed stride 1 when stride 2 was correct; adjusted new fixture duration, not engine/goldens/timeouts. First 105/106 failure retained separately.
Wide canvas stretching versus SVG corrected using contain sizing and matching centered SVG projection; renderer unit and production browser alignment verified.
Initial 4 visual tests reported missing baselines and created 12 new images; not counted as passing. Old images unchanged; frozen comparisons subsequently passed in the expanded CP2 run.
Two readonly-array assignments in the new model aliasing test caused typecheck errors; Reflect.set preserved the runtime mutation check and typecheck passed.

First expanded browser run passed 87/88; retained mock keyboard/reflow exceeded 30 seconds during axe. Isolated rerun passed desktop but timed out on mobile. Splitting viewport journeys still accumulated five panel audits (3/4 passed). Each panel was then separated into its own test, in both retained mock and spatial journeys, preserving every original assertion and the unchanged 30-second limit. Failure reports are retained separately from the passing per-panel run.
Independent documentation review corrected route-departure preservation wording: config/tray survive, current trajectory does not.

Final browser run passed 60/62; two Chromium cases timed out across long execution gaps. unsafe-imports first navigation reported ERR_NETWORK_IO_SUSPENDED with about 52 minutes between browser and runner records; frozen-layouts lasted about 117 minutes with screenshot/teardown execution gaps and no recorded screenshot mismatch assertion. Actual OS sleep is not established. Original JSON and traces preserved; identical fixed-baseline manual recovery passed both cases on desktop/mobile (4/4). Latest exact file/title-path/project results cover all 62 required cases; this is not a single uninterrupted 62/62 run.
